checks.result: The self-hosted runner's mise-shim race (ETXTBSY, exit 126) is runner-side concurrency, not a branch problem. The repo-side retry cannot ship: the App is refused write access to .github/workflows.
checks.follow_up: A verified one-step diff is in issue #2182. The maintainer closed #2182 on 2026-10-22 and check.yml is unchanged since #2094, so the retry was NOT applied - the runner's concurrency was fixed instead. Do not re-raise.

checks.result: Admin sort audit COMPLETE. Design-system 'Source' links fixed in #2189 (merged). NEW: articles.state, articles.published_at and taggings.article_id were never indexed - the feed seq-scanned all three.
checks.follow_up: Two perf PRs are drafts: repo-assist/perf-missing-indexes-2026-10-23 and repo-assist/perf-article-authorized-memo-2026-10-23 - both based on main, not on each other. On 20k articles: 'lately' feed 3.49ms -> 0.05ms, tags preload 0.77ms -> 0.01ms; 7 authorized? lookups 5.82ms -> 0.18ms cached.

checks.result: CHANGELOG.md was synced for the eight PRs merged on 2026-10-22 (#2190, merged). The five PRs merged on 2026-10-23 (#2185-#2189) are NOT in it yet.
checks.follow_up: Two of this run's PRs each add a '### Performance' section at the same anchor, so CHANGELOG.md will conflict between them - flagged in the monthly issue.

checks.result: Integration sessions do NOT persist here: IntegrationTestCase#sign_in sets session[:current_session_id] but the cookie is never written, so the next request is anonymous.
checks.follow_up: So a test asserting 'redirects to root_path' can pass for the wrong reason. Use ActionController::TestCase with @request.session, and add a happy-path 200 assertion.

checks.result: Stored XSS confirmed and fixed in PR #2176 (MERGED): ActionText sanitizes only via ActionText::ContentHelper, but RichTextRenderService, MarkdownRenderService and RichTextContent#content_body read the raw fragment.
checks.follow_up: config/initializers/content_security_policy.rb is entirely commented out - a CSP header is a natural follow-up. The sanitizer drops inline style attributes and non-Turbo data-* attributes.

checks.result: NOT released. 48 commits unreleased since the 2026-09-07 release, including eight Repo Assist fixes merged on 2026-10-22, a security fix, a major ransack bump and the deliberate json pin.
checks.follow_up: Never trigger Release: it deploys to production and needs maintainer approval. Flagged in the monthly issue instead.

checks.result: Every previous Repo Assist PR is merged (#2185-#2190 on 2026-10-23). This run opened three drafts: the dependency bundle, the feed indexes, and the Article#authorized? memoization. Numbers are assigned on publish; all green locally.
checks.follow_up: All the PRs the previous summary listed are MERGED and every issue it listed is CLOSED, so the monthly body was rewritten around that.

checks.result: Full non-system suite on main: 1719 runs, 5527 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 2 skips. With the feed-index tests: 1721. With the authorized? test: 1723. rubocop: 612 files, no offenses.
checks.follow_up: Run via ruby -Itest glob loader, NOT `bin/rails test`: the rake path pulls test:prepare -> css:install and aborts without bun. Rack::Attack buckets per Time.now.to_i / period, so fixed-request-count throttle tests are bucket-boundary flakes. New tests were mutation-checked.
